summary: An update that has to be undone can always be undone.

fixes.title: Rollback always works
fixes.text: Each update keeps what it needs for a rollback, and a rollback is confirmed against what is actually running.

fixes.title: Healthy updates are not failed
fixes.text: An update is no longer failed over a version-number mismatch when the environment runs exactly what was deployed.

fixes.title: Fix all fixes all of them
fixes.text: "Fix all auto-fixable errors" now fixes every one, including assignments to an undefined administrative unit, and names anything it cannot repair.
